optionalLayers.label: County parcels
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: APN -> White Rabbit accountNum/sourceParcelId; OBJECTID -> GIS object id; viewport chunks and search shards are built but remain activation gated
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source fetch, offline universal mapping, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Owner/appraisal
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: APN joins owner, mailing, situs, sale/deed, land size, zoning text, jurisdiction, construction year, living space, and current/previous value fields; phone/email remain blank
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source fetch, offline owner/appraisal normalization, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Parcel dimensions
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: Parcel service exposes LAND_SIZE, Shape__Area, and Shape__Length; ParcelLabel MapServer needs inspection for dimension labels
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source inspection, offline mapping, viewport chunks

optionalLayers.label: Block, subdivision, and map-grid context
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: Parcel fields include SUBNAME, LOT_NUM, BLOCK, TRACT, STR, MCRNUM/MCR_BOOK/MCR_PAGE; map/section services can provide spatial context
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source inspection, offline joins, viewport chunks

optionalLayers.label: Permits and certificates of occupancy
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: source-needed: parcel/account, normalized address, or spatial point-in-parcel join
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source verification, offline permit normalization, viewport-safe chunks

optionalLayers.label: Zoning intelligence
optionalLayers.source: CITY_ZONING field in Maricopa Assessor Parcels_view plus local jurisdiction detail still needed
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: APN-keyed parcel field CITY_ZONING gives zoning text, but many records may require local jurisdiction zoning detail
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source verification, offline joins, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Floodplain intelligence
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: source-needed: FEMA/local floodplain spatial join keyed back to parcel/account IDs
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source verification, offline parcel centroid spatial join, viewport-safe sharded parcel ID lookup

optionalLayers.label: Migration and demand
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: source-needed: aggregate Census/ACS/IRS or approved demand geography joined by tract/block group/market, not individual people
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time aggregate demand scoring, offline geography-to-parcel join, viewport-safe parcel index lookup

publicSourceDiscovery.priorityReason: Large Sun Belt market with strong real estate demand signals.
sourceSearchQueries: Maricopa County assessor parcel data GIS
sourceRules: Use official county, assessor/appraiser, GIS, municipal, state, or federal sources first.
Do not activate this county until exact parcel counts and join keys are verified.
Do not infer owner phone/email from permits, contractors, applicants, or scraped pages.

ownerEnrichment.officialJoinKey: APN -> owner, mailing, situs, sale/deed, land size, zoning text, jurisdiction, construction year, living space, and current/previous value fields
ownerEnrichment.noOfficialEmailFieldNote: No official owner phone/email field is exposed by the verified parcel service. Do not infer owner contact fields.

fields.ownerPhone: No official owner phone field verified
fields.ownerEmail: No official owner email field verified

joinKeys.appraisal: APN -> FCV_CUR, LPV_CUR, LC_CUR, TAX_YR_CUR, FCV_PREV, LPV_PREV, LC_PREV
joinKeys.land: APN -> LAND_SIZE, PUC, CITY_ZONING, JURISDICTION, CONST_YEAR, LIVING_SPACE
joinKeys.blockLabels: Direct parcel fields SUBNAME, LOT_NUM, BLOCK, TRACT, STR, MCRNUM/MCR_BOOK/MCR_PAGE; optional spatial joins to SubdivisionOutline/Sections/MapIDs remain build-needed
joinKeys.dimensions: LAND_SIZE, Shape__Area, and Shape__Length available; ParcelLabel MapServer needs inspection for segment dimension labels
joinKeys.permits: source-needed: parcel/account ID, address match, spatial join, or combination
joinKeys.zoning: CITY_ZONING field is APN-keyed parcel zoning text; municipal zoning polygons/cases remain source-needed where the field says contact local jurisdiction
joinKeys.floodplain: source-needed: FEMA/local floodplain parcel centroid spatial join keyed to parcel/account IDs
joinKeys.migrationDemand: source-needed: aggregate geography join, not individual people

productionGap: Pilot source verified with full viewport chunks and production search shards built, but permits/CO, full local zoning detail, floodplain, development signals, migration/demand, PMTiles/vector tiles, and activation QA are not built yet.
pilotNotes: Do not activate this county in the app. Do not redesign any pages. The Maricopa source is verified and the map/search parcel service is built, but the county remains activation gated until QC, optional layers, and explicit activation review pass.
